name: 拉丝钢红外感应静音垃圾桶款

category.leaf: 红外感应自动开盖不锈钢垃圾桶（家用客厅卧室带盖垃圾桶）

description: 冷灰感应科技调性，变径拉丝桶身，三模开盖、俯视开合序列与四问痛点宫格

styleLock.backgroundSystem: one material per screen: a pale mist-grey studio wall #ECEEF1 meeting a light lime-wash floor for claim and packshot screens, seamless white #FFFFFF for grid and cell screens, deep charcoal tech panel #1C1F22 for mechanism and trust screens; the night bedroom screen alone is a real dim bedroom; never a random or mixed environment
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool neutral studio light with one dominant side key, a long thin specular band travelling down the brushed steel body, narrow rim highlight on the rolled rim, honest elliptical contact shadow under the base ring; the single night screen switches to a low warm bedside key around 2700K while keeping the same shadow logic
styleLock.surfaceSystem: pale micro-cement wall, light oak-tone floorboards, white card grid, charcoal matte tech plinth; no props larger than the bin and no scenic decoration
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, headlines in #1C1F22 on light screens and #ECEEF1 on charcoal screens, one thin rule line and one small kicker line as the only ornament; short Chinese lines only inside 「」 placeholders, no serif, no handwriting, no brush calligraphy, no cartoon lettering
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons and one-dot leader lines with sensor-blue #4A7DA8 outlines inside small rounded frames, low complexity, no filled pictograms, no 3D gloss icons, no real brand marks
styleLock.presentationRules: the same tapered round body with its wide rolled steel rim collar, top sensor lid and contrasting base ring keeps true scale and proportions in every screen; the lid is drawn in the exact state the shot asks for and never redesigned; the rim stays fully inside the frame; contact shadow always present; hands only as anonymous cropped forearm or fingertip, never a face
noDrift: no invented capacity, dimensions, response time, delay seconds, cycle life, steel grade, coating layers, sterilization or antibacterial claims, certifications or store badges
no added pedal, handle, wheels, display screen or lamp that the product does not have
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool minimalist smart-home hardware ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of mist grey-white #ECEEF1, brushed steel grey #B7BCC2, deep charcoal #1C1F22 and one sensor-blue accent #4A7DA8; cool neutral studio lighting with one dominant side key, a long thin specular band on the brushed body and honest contact shadows, only the night screen warming to a 2700K bedside key; modern geometric sans-serif headlines with short Chinese copy kept inside 「」; thin single-weight line icons and dot leader lines in sensor-blue rounded frames; one background material per screen, either a pale mist-grey wall with a light floor, a seamless white card grid, or a deep charcoal tech panel; the tapered round bin with its wide rolled rim, top sensor lid and base ring kept true to scale with the rim fully in frame; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented capacity, dimensions, response time, delay seconds, cycle life, steel grade, coating layers, sterilization or antibacterial claims, certifications or store badges.
